code.text: Site-specific radiation dose at tooth #30 (dosimetric dental contouring / DDC) — NO ESTABLISHED LOINC CODE. This is a named ODE IG test objective/gap: radiation dose data transmitted from a radiation planning system to a dental EHR has no established LOINC code as of this writing.

performer.display: Teh Lin, MS, FACMP — Medical Physicist, FCCC

bodySite.text: Tooth #30 (FDI/universal numbering per US dental convention)

interpretation.text: Exceeds the 45 Gy safe healing threshold for pre-radiation dental extraction — informs Dr. Sollecito's decision to extract and immediately place an implant rather than delay extraction until after radiation.

note.text: This value was obtained via an informal inter-provider information request: Dr. Sollecito asked Dr. Teh Lin (FCCC Medical Physics) on 2026-07-23 for site-specific dose data at tooth #30, extracted from the IMRT treatment plan already ordered in Interaction 1. Per project design decision, this request/response exchange is modeled as a note (this one), not as a formal ServiceRequest or CommunicationRequest/Communication — see fhir-resources/uc01-medical-to-dental/interactions/README.md for the full reasoning (a confirmed, legitimate instance of the base Clinical Order Workflows IG's 'Requesting additional information' pattern, which is not carried into the 360X-scoped crosswalk this project's referral pathway otherwise follows). Data transmitted 2026-07-25, two days after the request — this transmission date is not modeled as its own clinical encounter (see use case Appendix Section 0).
